tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// ri khrod lo ma can gyi bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs// kun du zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing dang yul rnams kun du rnam 'phrul zhing*// khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba// ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang*// sna tshogs mdog dang sna tshogs cha lugs dang*// sna tshogs rgyan dang sna tshogs phyag mtshan gyis// rnam par sgeg pa khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// khyad par gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas// me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam spud pa'i// shing lo gsar pa'i na bzas rab klubs pa// lo ma gyon pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi rig sngags zhi ba'i nga ro yis// 'gro ba'i rims dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas// gdug pa 'joms mdzad gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zhi bas 'gro ba zhi mdzad cing*// brtse bas rjes chags dgyes pa chen po yis// tshe dang dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas mdzad ma// rnam grol yangs pa'i thugs mnga' khyed la 'dud// sgrub dang bzlas brjod brtson pas nyid kyi thugs// bskul bas bdag la brtse ba nyer dgongs nas// bgegs dang nad sogs sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*// tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol// skye ba kun du bdag gi mgon mdzad de// nyam nga'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab pa dang*// srid zhi'i bde dga' rgya mtshos rab 'byor cing*// rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur bar mdzod// rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi bstod pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas chu mig dpal gyi bde chen du sbyar ba'o//

//oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he dun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ ti ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
